threadDescriptions.island-permit: Secure the overnight camping permit and pitch at Heron Island.
threadDescriptions.ferry-bikes: Book and prepare bicycles for ferry transport to Heron Island.
threadDescriptions.night-sky: Prepare a sky-photography session during the island stay.
threadDescriptions.balcony-plants: Set up watering for balcony plants while away.

items.text: Heron Island overnight permits opened. Request two adults at the north meadow pitch for 18 May; no fires allowed.
Tom's wide bike tyres may not fit ferry rack slots. Send the ferry office a side photo before reserving cycle spaces.
Island sky session: take the small tracker and a 24 mm lens. Want the beacon at the edge of the frame, not in the middle.
items.rationale: Defines intended photography composition and gear.

items.text: Balcony pots dried out last trip. Trial a wick from the big bucket into each herb pot before we leave.
North meadow permit provisional, reference HN-28. Ranger wants arrival ferry time before assigning the pitch.
Ferry says wide tyres go on the floor straps. Two passenger tickets and two cycles held on the 10:40 boat.
Tracker batteries held charge overnight. Run another test with the cold pack; the island can be windy after sunset.
HN? 28? pencil rubbed out below the number.
items.rationale: Partial identifier alone gives inadequate purpose.

items.text: Herb wick trial flooded the mint tray. Raise bucket to the same level as the pots, not above them.
Ferry timetable correction from office: 10:40 sailing cancelled for inspection. Our two bikes and passengers moved to 12:10; confirmation attached.

Permit update for HN-28: give ranger the new 12:10 ferry arrival plan and request late pitch check-in. Ferry office also needs our camping permit number added to the bicycle group booking; reply to both confirmations.
items.rationale: Actionable coordination updates both permit and transport bookings.

items.text: Beacon test frame from last scouting visit: even the short exposure flares across the centre. Put the camera east of the post and shade the lens with the hood.
items.rationale: Develops photographic setup from test image.

items.text: Heron north meadow permit issued for two adults, one night. Ranger marked the pitch beyond the hand pump; print the no-fire conditions.
Ferry loading rehearsal: unclip both panniers and tie the front wheel so it cannot turn while the wide-tyre bike is strapped down.
Watering trial day two: mint tray damp, basil upright. Bucket line dropped about one centimetre; mark the full level before departure.
Remember the adapter. It's on the shelf.
items.rationale: No device or thread can be identified.

items.text: Sky forecast note for Heron outing: if haze hides the stars, make a long exposure of the beacon reflection. Pack the neutral-density filter for that fallback.
Heron permit printout now in the dry pouch. Check out with the ranger by ten Sunday so the pitch isn't marked occupied.
Ferry cycle booking shows floor straps for both bikes and the 12:10 departure. Tom has a screenshot for the ticket office.
Tripod feet washed; lens hood and spare tracker batteries in camera pouch. Beacon composition sketch taped inside.
items.rationale: Final equipment preparation for island photography.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: a beacon photograph is photography planning, despite being taken on the same island.
